verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that BigCommerce offers REST and GraphQL APIs, an API Reference with a built-in Request Runner, and an llms.txt file. None of it documents a downloadable OpenAPI spec, GraphQL schema file, or equivalent machine-readable API definition. The Request Runner and llms.txt are adjacent features and do not count as a spec download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
